question: Are you open at 10pm tonight? I'm staying in Uluwatu.

final.questionTranslation: Apakah buka jam 10 malam ini? Saya menginap di Uluwatu.

answer.text: Our hours are 08:30 to 23:00 every day, so 10pm falls within our working hours. Our team will check whether we can come to Uluwatu and reply to you shortly.
answer.translation: Jam operasional kami adalah 08:30 hingga 23:00 setiap hari, jadi jam 10 malam masih termasuk jam kerja kami. Tim kami akan mengecek apakah kami bisa datang ke Uluwatu dan segera membalas Anda.
